image_description: A vintage typewriter with a cream-colored body and distinctive round, green keys. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the elongated space bar at the bottom center.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white characters on the green keys appear slightly soft and lack the crisp embossing or printing edges seen in high-resolution macro photography of real typewriters. There is a slight 'smudged' look to the lettering.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of space bar connection
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection point between the right end of the space bar and the adjacent key/chassis looks slightly fused or ill-defined, lacking a clear mechanical gap or hinge structure.
The metal bar at the top (carriage return) seems to warp slightly into the background casing, with inconsistent reflection highlights suggesting minor geometric instability.
